summary: PromptLens v2 iteration 2 end-to-end testing. Backend: 3/5 pytest passes; /api/health, /api/metrics/definitions, and /api/analyze/stream (SSE) all pass with proper start/result events. /api/analyze non-streaming returns 502 through the public ingress when HF is slow because backend retries take >60s (ingress timeout). Frontend: streaming analyze flow works end-to-end (streaming console -> analysis-view with radar, tabs, 10 metric cards, costs grid, rewrite panel with unified/split word-diff, copy/download). History drawer and /history page both work; /history row click preloads the analysis. Non-streaming mode shows loading-state and no streaming-console. Multiple testid mismatches vs spec: (a) `hallucination-card` missing (code emits `hallucination-risk-card`), (b) MetricsPage emits `metric-def-<key>` using raw underscored keys (e.g., `metric-def-hallucination_risk`) instead of dashed spec form. Compare page (/compare) hero, editors and compare-btn render, but compare-btn call hits /api/analyze which 502s so winner-summary never renders — Compare flow is currently BROKEN on the public URL.

critical.issue: Returns 502 (Bad Gateway) through public ingress under HF slowness. HF InferenceClient timeout=60s x 3 retries with delays (0,2,5) can push total request past 90s; the emergent preview ingress terminates at ~60s. Backend does eventually return 200 with heuristic fallback locally (confirmed via curl to :8001 -> 200 in 97s, source='heuristic'), but the client never sees it. This breaks the Compare page and any non-streaming analyze call in production.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing testid `hallucination-card` — code renders `hallucination-risk-card` because PRIMARY_KEYS includes `hallucination_risk` and testid template is `${k.replace(/_/g,'-')}-card`. Spec asks for `hallucination-card`.

metric-def-<key> testids use raw underscored keys, e.g. `metric-def-hallucination_risk`, `metric-def-instruction_strength`, `metric-def-context_richness`, `metric-def-bias_risk`. Spec expects dashed form (`metric-def-hallucination-risk`, etc.). Fix: `data-testid={`metric-def-${m.key.replace(/_/g,'-')}`}` in MetricsPage.jsx.

6 of 10 metric cards (Readability, Structure, Instruction Strength, Context Richness, Verbosity, Bias Risk) do not display a Formula section — spec says each card should show description + formula. The static METRIC_FALLBACK entries for those keys have empty `formula` string.

integration_issues.issue: compare-btn triggers /api/analyze for both prompts which returns 502 via ingress (see backend critical). winner-summary, score-radar overlay, metric-compare-list, compare-row-* never render. Compare page is unusable in production until backend is fixed or Compare switches to /api/analyze/stream.

issues: React 'does not recognize %s prop on a DOM element' warnings still repeat (MUI v7 prop leakage from prior iteration, unfixed)

action_items: Backend: shorten HF retry budget for /api/analyze so total end-to-end < 55s (e.g., 2 attempts, per-call timeout 20s, or drop retries when a 504 is seen), OR switch /api/analyze to stream first-token-quickly / heuristic-first with async HF enrichment. Current behavior 502s on preview ingress.
Frontend: rename testid in AnalysisTabs Overview mapping so the 4th primary card is `hallucination-card` (special-case that key, since PRIMARY_KEYS contains `hallucination_risk`).

Frontend: fill in `formula` strings for readability/structure/instruction_strength/context_richness/verbosity/bias_risk in METRIC_FALLBACK (and confirm backend /api/metrics/definitions returns non-empty formula for these).
Frontend: consider using /api/analyze/stream on Compare page so it survives HF slowness (Compare is currently blocked by the backend 502 issue).

AnalysisTabs.jsx:154 testid derived from raw key — collides with spec name `hallucination-card` for the hallucination_risk metric.
MetricsPage.jsx:24 uses raw m.key without underscore-to-dash normalization, breaking testids for 4 metrics.

If backend HF retries are shortened, retest: Compare (/compare) full flow including winner-summary, metric-compare-list, compare-row-clarity, compare-row-verbosity. Also retest after `hallucination-card` and `metric-def-*` dashed testids are added. Test data currently in localStorage 'promptlens.history.v1' — clear via /history clear-history-page-btn between runs.
rca of the issue: Root cause of Compare page failure & analyze 502: server.py `call_hf_analysis` performs up to 3 blocking chat_completion attempts with per-call timeout=60s and inter-call delays 0/2/5s. When HF returns 504 (currently frequent), total wall time on the endpoint exceeds the emergent preview ingress read timeout (~60s) — ingress emits 502 to the client before backend can execute its heuristic fallback and return 200. Streaming path is unaffected because it flushes `type:start` immediately, so the ingress keeps the connection open. Mitigation: (a) reduce retry attempts to 2 and per-call timeout to 20s, or (b) fail-fast to heuristic on the first 504, or (c) have the Compare page call /api/analyze/stream twice and parse the final result event.
